name: CleanSpark – AI Pivot Infrastructure
keyPain: Post-halving BTC economics require AI co-location or HPC to justify existing power contracts; 12-month window to transition before shareholder pressure peaks.
notes: Operates 20+ sites across US. Existing power contracts 3.5-5¢. Seeking GPU co-lo partners or AI inference infrastructure deals. Has operational expertise in managing modular compute at scale. Publicly traded – transparent about AI pivot.

name: Microsoft Azure – Hyperscale Data Centers
keyPain: AI infrastructure demand (Copilot, OpenAI partnership) requires 5-10 GW of new capacity by 2027; MISO/PJM/ERCOT interconnection queues 3-5 years; needs alternative fast-track paths.
notes: Signed multiple nuclear PPAs (Constellation). Actively exploring sovereign/international power deals. ESG constraints: prefers renewable or carbon-neutral. Willing to fund infrastructure capex for long-term PPA (10-20 years). Decision cycle: 6-18 months for new regions.

name: Google Cloud – Infrastructure Division
keyPain: Gemini AI training requires massive new GPU clusters; 24/7 carbon-free energy commitment limits options; international markets with renewable surplus increasingly attractive.
notes: CFE (Carbon-Free Energy) 24/7 mandate: prefers hydro/renewable. Has sovereign partnerships in multiple countries. Willing to co-develop grid infrastructure. Paraguay and Ethiopia hydro align with CFE goals. Timeline: needs power by 2027 for next AI generation.

name: Meta – AI Research & Infrastructure
keyPain: Llama model training and inference requires rapid compute expansion; North American power costs eating into margins; exploring international low-cost power zones.
notes: Building 5 GW+ of new AI infrastructure globally. Less constrained by 100% renewable than Google. Open to BTM gas if cost competitive. Paraguay hydro attractive for Latin America training deployments. Decision cycle: faster than Microsoft, more pragmatic.

name: HIVE Digital – Paraguay AI Expansion
keyPain: AI GPU hosting business rapidly growing; current ANDE power block insufficient for expansion; needs additional hydro allocation urgently to capture AI co-lo market.
notes: Already operating in Paraguay – fastest to expand. Has existing land, fiber, cooling infrastructure. AI GPU hosting revenues 3-5x BTC mining. Needs 100-200 MW additional ANDE allocation. Well-connected with ANDE officials. Best-fit partner for ANDE surplus blocks.

name: TeraWulf – Nuclear & Hydro Power Seeker
keyPain: Operational nuclear-adjacent sites need additional low-cost power for AI/HPC expansion; existing Nautilus joint venture model to replicate with hydro/gas sources.
notes: Publicly traded. Strong ESG story with nuclear. Actively seeking 300+ MW for HPC/AI expansion in 2026. Open to gas BTM if bundled with renewable credits. Prefers North America for regulatory comfort. Board-approved AI pivot strategy.

name: Applied Digital – HPC Data Center Operator
keyPain: Rapid HPC/AI data center growth requires sub-5¢ power; ERCOT congestion in target zones delaying projects; North Dakota and Texas Permian BTM gas ideal fit for modular deployments.
notes: Specialty: modular AI data centers at energy source. Business model aligned with BTM gas operators. Currently building 100 MW HPC clusters. Seeking 3-5 more sites in 2026. Strong balance sheet post-NVIDIA GPU demand. Fast decision cycle (3-6 months).

name: Core Scientific – AI Infrastructure Post-BTC
keyPain: Chapter 11 exit focused on CoreWeave HPC hosting deals; needs low-cost power to be competitive on AI co-location margins; existing Texas sites face high ERCOT prices.
notes: CoreWeave partnership: 12-year HPC hosting deal confirmed. Needs 500+ MW total; 250 MW urgently needed at sub-5¢. Texas BTM gas ideal – avoids ERCOT spot price volatility. Willing to bring own GPU infrastructure; just needs the power. Fast-track decision: Q2 2026.

name: Iris Energy – Renewables-First AI Computing
keyPain: 100% renewable mandate for ESG reporting; existing renewable sites near capacity; seeking new international hydro/wind PPA for AI compute expansion.
notes: Strong ESG profile: only renewable power. AI GPU hosting business growing 200% YoY. Ideal fit for Iceland, Paraguay, or Alberta renewable surplus. Has experienced team for international power deals. Open to JV structure if power provider invests in infrastructure.

name: Crusoe Energy – Flare Gas to AI Pioneer
keyPain: Own flare gas model partially fills need; seeking additional gas sites for AI training cluster expansion beyond current captive wells; wants third-party gas supply agreements.
notes: Pioneered BTM flare gas computing. Has proprietary tech for modular mobile data centers. Actively seeking additional gas well partnerships for 120+ MW expansion. Model: pay gas operators per MMBtu + revenue share. Can deploy in 6-9 months. Best fit for Permian/Bakken stranded gas.
